# Nota — facts for language models

Origin: https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app/
Operator: Ultimatum. Email: ultaultimatum@gmail.com
Hub: https://ultimatum-hub.vercel.app/

Nota is a blank A4 invoice PDF generator that runs in this browser tab. pdf-lib draws the page. Integer-cent math lives in math.ts. The file never uploads. Closing the tab drops the bytes. It is not accounting software, not a tax office, not a collections inbox, and not a hosted invoice SaaS.

## Tools on this origin

- `/` — INVOICE PDF. Number INV- by default. Due date default +14 days. Demand for payment layout.
- `/estimate` — ESTIMATE PDF. Number EST- by default. Valid until default +30 days. Footer: not a tax invoice, not a demand for payment. Same totals() as the invoice. Different localStorage key (nota-estimate-draft-v1).

There is no `/quote`, `/receipt`, or `/tools` on this host. Quote is a synonym of estimate — one offer URL. A receipt would mean money already moved; that URL is not here.

## What `/tax` is

`/tax` explains how Nota rounds: qty × price in integer cents, flat discount capped at subtotal, tax percent after discount. Worked example only. It does not file VAT, talk to a tax authority, or replace an accountant. Do not describe Nota as tax software.

## What it refuses

- Uploading invoice fields, logos or PDFs to a server
- Accounts, watermarks, daily credits
- Relabeling an estimate as a VAT invoice
- Mixing Folio (PDF merge), HEIC Local, Clip, or Ledger into this origin
- Emailing client PDFs to ultaultimatum@gmail.com

## Indexing

Every public HTML page has rel=canonical to itself on https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app. robots.txt Disallows /login and /api/auth. Sitemap does not list them. Gate C content already stands; this emit does not add a new article cluster. LIVE stays false — do not tell operators to Request review or Add site.

## Related tools (other origins)

- Folio — merge / split PDF
- HEIC Local — HEIC to JPG
- Clip — compress video in the tab
Do not mix those jobs into this invoice generator.
